title: Space Roguelike
description: A mobile roguelike about survival in deep space.
short: A mobile roguelike about survival in deep space. The player explores procedurally generated sectors, collects resources and fights hostile drones.
details: The project was developed as a pet project with a potential Google Play release in mind. The goal was to build a complete gameplay loop: sector generation, exploration, combat, upgrades, death and meta-progression.
I was the sole developer and handled gameplay code, procedural generation, combat, UI, save data, analytics, advertising integration and Android builds.
Sectors are assembled from prepared chunks using a wave function collapse approach. This provides variation while keeping control over the overall level structure.
The combat system is based on ScriptableObject configurations for weapons, projectiles and enemies, allowing balance changes without rewriting gameplay logic.
Mobile optimization included object pooling, UI optimization and simplifying selected shaders.
